'''Gostel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] he was stationed at the [[Vaiken Spacedock]], administering alien criminals recruited by the Empire on [[Belsavis prison]] prior to the [[Dread Host]] takeover of [[Section X]].
